name: shipit-agent-cli
description: Pinned, lockfile-driven install of the agent CLIs baked into ShipIt images. See docs/141-cli-version-strategy. Versions are bumped by the Renovate GitHub App (cooldown via minimumReleaseAge) and gated on the CLI contract test; do not edit by hand without regenerating package-lock.json. playwright-stable is not a CLI: it is the newest stable playwright-core, whose browser builds the images bake for a project's own Playwright (docs/335-project-playwright-browsers).
